Airbus Forecasts 9.3% Annual Growth in India's Air Travel

Airbus has projected a 9.3% annual growth rate for India's domestic air traffic, expecting this trend to continue through 2045. This forecast is attributed to a significant boom in the aviation sector. The company's outlook suggests that medium-term economic growth in India will be driven by consumption and investment revival, with infrastructure playing a key role in the BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance) sector's expansion until 2030.
